data.long_meaning: Anika is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘anu’ meaning ‘towards’ and ‘kam’ meaning ‘desire’ or ‘pleasure’. This name signifies a being that brings grace, beauty, and pleasure towards one's life. The name Anika carries the meaning “Graceful, beautiful, pleasing” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Anika usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, beautiful, pleasing and live with faith, good character and purpose.
